item.title: From call taker to problem solver: Breaking the cycle with evidence-based policing
item.description: Evidence-based, problem-oriented policing helps officers reduce repeat crime, solve chronic problems and reclaim pride in the job

item.title: New synthetic opioid may resist naloxone, forensic officials warn
item.description: Tennessee investigators identify cychlorphine in fatal overdoses and advise officers to follow fentanyl safety protocols as toxicology data continues to develop

item.title: N.Y. AG will not charge officers in fatal OIS of man who hit LEO in the head with an 8 lb. clamp
item.description: Officers were on the scene due to suicide hotline calls and to keep the man away from his young son; as a state trooper tried to move the boy away from the scene, the man struck her in the head

item.title: Mich. PD shooting prompts upgrade to officers’ mental wellness program
item.description: Roseville PD officers will now have a mental wellness counselor available to them 24/7; the change follows an incident where an officer was shot by a barricaded gunman

item.title: BWC: NYPD cops rescue injured bald eagle stranded on ice float
item.description: Using a catch pole and a plastic tarp, the officers were able to pull the eagle to safety on the boat

item.title: Capitol police arrest man who ran toward the U.S. Capitol building with shotgun
item.description: The suspect was reportedly wearing a tactical vest and gloves and had a Kevlar helmet and gas mask in the vehicle; the shotgun was loaded and he had additional rounds on him

item.title: Mich. PD to switch from Sig P320 to Glock Gen 6, chief cites safety concerns
item.description: The Grand Blanc Township board approved a motion to purchase 50 Glock Gen 6 9MM handguns with sights, along with new holsters and other equipment for $48,256.50

item.title: BWC: Colo. officers find 3 children in trunk during suspected DUI stop
item.description: After being handcuffed, the driver told Westminster Police officers, “My kids are in the trunk," leading to the discovery of three children inside

item.title: BWC: Pursuit ends with PIT maneuver before driver shoots at Minn. deputies
item.description: St. Louis County deputies returned fire, fatally wounding the driver, who initially fled a traffic stop
